eastern-philosophy-and-the-self.title: Eastern Philosophy and the Self
eastern-philosophy-and-the-self.description: Three traditions, one question: what is the self? Confucius locates it in relationships, Buddhism denies it has any fixed core, and Daoism asks what that means for how you're supposed to act.

how-ai-got-here.title: How AI Got Here
how-ai-got-here.description: How a 70-year-old question — can a machine think? — turned into ordinary infrastructure, and what that transformation cost along the way.
